title: Voting on stories, concepts and proposals, with downvotes
description:
Needs Papyrus: reader votes on any subject type (today: items and submissions only), plus downvotes, and the flags "This is wrong", "This belongs under…" and "Suggest a better name" with a short reason.

Any signed-in reader can vote, with no karma gate. Signed-out readers see the controls and get the inline Google sign-in prompt that returns them to the same spot.

Acceptance: a signed-in reader can up- and downvote a proposal and a story, and the snapshot shows net counts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and live: Papyrus 5.31.0 and Shipped f80a571 (subjects item, submission, story and proposal; voteSubjects on every page). Story votes and flags are live (#78). Proposal voting shows once the first proposal exists (ship-37026d).
